audience: IT and operations teams that publish a status page with StatusCast

useCases.title: Check the current status of your services
useCases.text: Read the page status and the components with their state.

useCases.title: Review the uptime of a component
useCases.text: Find a component and read its uptime for a period.

useCases.title: Review past incidents
useCases.text: Search the incidents and open one to read the updates.

useCases.title: Check the group incidents and templates
useCases.text: List the group incidents and the content templates for incident posts.
